source_text:
17.49 ̔Ο ῥύστης μου ἐξ ἐχθρῶν ὀργίλων. ̓Εν οι ς θυμὸς ἐπικρατεῖ, ἐν τούτοις καὶ
ὀργιλότης· εἰ δὲ ἐχθροὶ ἡμῶν ο ργιλοί εἰσιν, οἱ ἐχθροὶ ἡμῶν α ρα θυμωδεῖς εἰσιν·
θυμὸς γὰρ αὐτῶν, φησὶ, κατὰ τὴν ὁμοίωσιν τοῦ ο φεως, καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀργισθῆναι τὸν
θυμὸν αὐτοῦ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς.
pass_a_gloss: The deliverer of-me out-of enemies wrathful. In whom wrath prevails, in these also irascibility; if but enemies of-us irascible are, the enemies of-us then wrathful are; wrath for of-them, he-says, according-to the likeness of-the serpent, and in the to-be-angered the wrath of-him upon us.
pass_b_english: In those in whom wrath prevails, in these also is irascibility; and if our enemies are irascible, our enemies then are wrathful; for their wrath, he says, is according to the likeness of the serpent, and in his wrath being angered upon us.

choices.why: ὀργίλος is irascible, not ‘from enemies of organs’ or ‘from angry organs’.
rejected: from enemies of wrath only as a title

choices.term: θυμὸς γὰρ αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν ὁμοίωσιν τοῦ ὄφεως
choices.english: their wrath is according to the likeness of the serpent
choices.why: Psalm 57:5. OCR ο φεως is ὄφεως, not light or voice.
rejected: their wrath is like the light
their wrath is like a voice

choices.term: εἰ δὲ ἐχθροὶ ἡμῶν ὀργίλοί εἰσιν, οἱ ἐχθροὶ ἡμῶν ἄρα θυμώδεις εἰσιν
choices.english: if our enemies are irascible, our enemies then are wrathful
choices.why: OCR α ρα is ἄρα ‘then’, not ‘curse’. Irascibility implies wrath.
rejected: if our enemies are irascible, they are a curse
our enemies are therefore not wrathful

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
